items.title: Lew Soloff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: Everybody could read well in that band... The only one who couldn’t read well was Steve Katz.

ctx.x: Everybody could read well in that band. Jimmy Fielder was the bass player, he was a hell of a musician. All the horn players could read. The only one who couldn’t read well was Steve Katz. Hi Steve. No he couldn’t read well, but he played with a lot of feeling. But everybody could read in that band.
